description: Setup-then-Readiness evaluation — runs /setup on a bare project, then /readiness to verify the scaffolded project scores well

test_cases.name: setup-then-readiness
test_cases.description: Run /setup to scaffold a Node/TS Express project, then /readiness to verify it scores Level 3+.

steps.label: Setup
steps.prompt: Run /setup on this project IN THE CURRENT DIRECTORY — do not create a subdirectory. Here are my answers to your Socratic questions: I am building a REST API. Use Node.js with TypeScript and Express as the framework. The project name is myapp but set it up in this directory, not in a myapp/ subdirectory. Please proceed with the full setup without asking me further questions — use those answers directly. IMPORTANT: Skip npm install and dependency installation — just create the files and configs. For verification (Phase 6), skip the linter check since dependencies are not installed.

steps.label: Readiness
steps.prompt: Run /readiness on this project. Output the full readiness report.
